name: How do I keep a shower niche from becoming a dirty, moldy mess?

mainEntity.name: How do I keep a shower niche from becoming a dirty, moldy mess?

acceptedAnswer.text:
A shower niche may become difficult to clean when it has many small compartments, rough stone, deep corners, or a flat shelf that collects residue. A simpler layout with smooth, well-finished surfaces can reduce daily maintenance.

Key factors:
- Minimize unnecessary corners and narrow ledges.
- Choose finishes that tolerate regular bathroom cleaning.
- Make shelves deep enough for products but not so deep that the back is hard to reach.

Practical guidance: Show Elite Remodeling & Design the products you plan to store and ask how the proposed shelves will be cleaned. Discuss grout color, trim, shelf material, and access before finalizing the design. A larger niche is not always more convenient if it creates unused surfaces.

Plan the niche around cleaning habits as well as storage capacity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Use a properly waterproofed niche with pitched shelves, smooth cleanable finishes, manageable depth, and as few unnecessary corners as possible. Choose grout, trim, and shelf materials with maintenance in mind, and review the design using the products you actually store.
